# 1. Executive Summary

This report presents business recommendations based on retail sales, customer segmentation, inventory analysis, demand forecasting and recommendation engine results.

# 2. Load Business Data

```{r setup, include=FALSE} id="p8x4m2"
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

business_summary <- read.csv("../reports/business_summary.csv")
customer_segments <- read.csv("../reports/customer_segment_summary.csv")
recommendations <- read.csv("../reports/recommendation_summary.csv")
```

# 3. Overall Business Performance

```{r} id="r5k9w3"
kable(business_summary)
```

# 4. Customer Segmentation Insights

```{r} id="v2n6q8"
kable(customer_segments)

ggplot(customer_segments, aes(x = reorder(Segment, Customers), y = Customers, fill = Segment)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Customer Distribution by Segment",
    x = "Customer Segment",
    y = "Number of Customers"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# 5. Inventory Recommendation Summary

```{r} id="b7m3t1"
kable(recommendations)
```

# 6. Key Business Findings

- The United Kingdom contributes the largest share of historical revenue.
- November recorded the highest monthly revenue.
- Champions are the most valuable customer segment by revenue.
- Low-stock products require replenishment attention.
- Exponential Smoothing performed best among the three evaluated forecasting models.

# 7. Business Recommendations

## Sales Improvement

- Focus marketing campaigns on high-performing products.
- Review monthly sales trends to support promotional planning.
- Explore opportunities to expand beyond the largest revenue market.

## Customer Management

- Reward Champions with loyalty benefits.
- Create targeted campaigns for At Risk customers.
- Encourage repeat purchases from Potential Loyalists.
- Re-engage Hibernating customers.

## Inventory Optimization

- Monitor products below their reorder levels.
- Prioritize critical replenishment requirements.
- Review slow-moving products before ordering additional stock.
- Coordinate replenishment with suppliers.

## Demand Forecasting

- Use forecasting results as a planning reference.
- Monitor actual demand against predicted demand.
- Retrain models when updated sales data becomes available.

# 8. Implementation Plan

| Priority | Recommended Action |
|---|---|
| High | Review low-stock products |
| High | Retain valuable customers |
| Medium | Improve demand planning |
| Medium | Re-engage inactive customers |
| Medium | Review slow-moving products |

# 9. Conclusion

RetailPulse Kerala combines sales analysis, customer segmentation, inventory analytics, demand forecasting and recommendation techniques to support retail business decisions.

The recommendations can help improve customer retention, stock management and business planning.

# 10. Data Limitations

The main transaction dataset is international Online Retail II data covering December 2009 to December 2011. Kerala-specific store and inventory information is simulated separately. Inventory product IDs are not directly matched to sales StockCode values. Forecasts are based on historical data and are not live predictions.
